source.source_version: JP 36.7.22 (local XAPK label; bundle hashes authoritative)
source.boundary: 客户端预制体、动作树和原生地址是研究证据；同名匹配不证明跨版本一致，字段形状和方法地址不等于已恢复执行语义，也不增加 DPS 可执行技能数。

acceptedScope: Timed self Buff switches to one existing attack/heal mode; shared simulator targeting/attack clock and projectile travel remain the current execution model.
verified: Complete skill and selected-mode components carry no generalAbilities; source mode indices, damage type, hit count, blackboard keys, target filters and attribute formulas are retained.
Arene S1 retains UpdateAtkScaleByTraitData default 0.8 and applies block_cnt final_scaler 0; S2 lacks the trait scaler.
Podenco skill mode is RangedHeal, friend side and HP ratio ascending, ignoreHealFree false, excludeOwner false.
Provence skill selector enables max HP ratio 0.800000011920929, excluding-equal false.
inferred: Existing simulator hit/retarget phase, multi-hit same-contact dispatch, projectile speed, mode transition and exact priority tie order are adapters, not proof of native frame parity.
Drone priority comes from literal source tag drone and selector class/configuration; ties use the existing simulator enemy order.

excluded.skchr_halo_2: Chain projectile plus active sluggish Buff and waitForProjectileInvalid require the chain-specific source contract; not admitted by basic mode profile.
excluded.skchr_mint_1: Mode generalAbilities replace trait Buff; begin animation and dedicated area selector require a separate phase-aware trait/area group.
excluded.skchr_snakek_2: Channeling animation and disarm flag need the no-attack self-recovery group.
excluded.skchr_utage_1: Channeling animation and disarm flag need the no-attack self-recovery group.
